messages.content: Hey, it's your weekly check-in from Northline Care. Hope the week's been decent. Got a blood pressure reading handy?
Got it, logged that for you — 138/84. Anything else going on this week, or are we all set?
Nope that's it. Pretty quiet week out here.
Sounds good. I'll have your next check-in scheduled for same time next week. Take care.
